# EXPRESS (ISO 10303-11) concrete syntax, ported from Expressir's
# Parsanol-DSL grammar (lib/expressir/express/grammar/parser.rb).
# The DSL rules transliterate one-to-one; the tKEYWORD rules and
# anyKeyword are the KEYWORDS.each / inject(:|) loops expanded.
# Root: syntax (the DSL's root(:syntax)).

grammar Express version "0.1.0" {

  # character classes shared by the keyword boundary predicate
  ident_char = %x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / %x5F
  any_char = %x00-10FFFF

  abstractEntityDeclaration = (tABSTRACT) as abstractEntityDeclaration
  abstractSupertypeDeclaration = (((tABSTRACT tSUPERTYPE) [subtypeConstraint])) as abstractSupertypeDeclaration
  abstractSupertype = ((((tABSTRACT tSUPERTYPE) op_delim) / (tABSTRACT op_delim))) as abstractSupertype
  actualParameterList = (((op_leftparen [((parameter *(op_comma parameter))) as listOf_parameter]) op_rightparen)) as actualParameterList
  addLikeOp = ((((op_plus / op_minus) / tOR) / tXOR)) as addLikeOp
  aggregateInitializer = (((op_leftbracket [((element *(op_comma element))) as listOf_element]) op_rightbracket)) as aggregateInitializer
  aggregateSource = (simpleExpression) as aggregateSource
  aggregateType = ((((tAGGREGATE [ (op_colon typeLabel) ]) tOF) parameterType)) as aggregateType
  aggregationTypes = ((((arrayType / bagType) / listType) / setType)) as aggregationTypes
  algorithmHead = ((((*(declaration)) as declaration [constantDecl]) [localDecl])) as algorithmHead
  aliasStmt = (((((((((tALIAS variableId) tFOR) generalRef) (*(qualifier)) as qualifier) op_delim) (1*(stmt)) as stmt) tEND_ALIAS) (op_delim) as op_delim2)) as aliasStmt
  anyKeyword = (tABS / tABSTRACT / tACOS / tAGGREGATE / tALIAS / tAND / tANDOR / tARRAY / tAS / tASIN / tATAN / tBAG / tBASED_ON / tBEGIN / tBINARY / tBLENGTH / tBOOLEAN / tBY / tCASE / tCONSTANT / tCONST_E / tCOS / tDERIVE / tDIV / tELSE / tEND / tEND_ALIAS / tEND_CASE / tEND_CONSTANT / tEND_ENTITY / tEND_FUNCTION / tEND_IF / tEND_LOCAL / tEND_PROCEDURE / tEND_REPEAT / tEND_RULE / tEND_SCHEMA / tEND_SUBTYPE_CONSTRAINT / tEND_TYPE / tENTITY / tENUMERATION / tESCAPE / tEXISTS / tEXP / tEXTENSIBLE / tFALSE / tFIXED / tFOR / tFORMAT / tFROM / tFUNCTION / tGENERIC / tGENERIC_ENTITY / tHIBOUND / tHIINDEX / tIF / tIN / tINSERT / tINTEGER / tINVERSE / tLENGTH / tLIKE / tLIST / tLOBOUND / tLOCAL / tLOG / tLOG10 / tLOG2 / tLOGICAL / tLOINDEX / tMOD / tNOT / tNUMBER / tNVL / tODD / tOF / tONEOF / tOPTIONAL / tOR / tOTHERWISE / tPI / tPROCEDURE / tQUERY / tREAL / tREFERENCE / tREMOVE / tRENAMED / tREPEAT / tRETURN / tROLESOF / tRULE / tSCHEMA / tSELECT / tSELF / tSET / tSIN / tSIZEOF / tSKIP / tSQRT / tSTRING / tSUBTYPE / tSUBTYPE_CONSTRAINT / tSUPERTYPE / tTAN / tTHEN / tTO / tTRUE / tTYPE / tTYPEOF / tTOTAL_OVER / tUNIQUE / tUNKNOWN / tUNTIL / tUSE / tUSEDIN / tVALUE / tVALUE_IN / tVALUE_UNIQUE / tVAR / tWITH / tWHERE / tWHILE / tXOR)
  arrayType = ((((((tARRAY boundSpec) tOF) [tOPTIONAL]) [tUNIQUE]) instantiableType)) as arrayType
  assignmentStmt = (((((generalRef (*(qualifier)) as qualifier) op_decl) expression) op_delim)) as assignmentStmt
  attributeDecl = ((attributeId / redeclaredAttribute)) as attributeDecl
  attributeId = (simpleId) as attributeId
  attributeQualifier = ((op_period attributeRef)) as attributeQualifier
  attributeRef = (attributeId) as attributeRef
  bagType = ((((tBAG [boundSpec]) tOF) instantiableType)) as bagType
  binaryLiteral = (spaces ((("%" 1*(bit))) as str)) as binaryLiteral
  binaryType = ((tBINARY [widthSpec])) as binaryType
  bit = (%x30 / "1")
  booleanType = (tBOOLEAN) as booleanType
  bound1 = (numericExpression) as bound1
  bound2 = (numericExpression) as bound2
  boundSpec = (((((op_leftbracket bound1) op_colon) bound2) op_rightbracket)) as boundSpec
  builtInConstant = ((((tCONST_E / tPI) / tSELF) / op_question_mark)) as builtInConstant
  builtInFunction = (((((((((((((((((((((((((((((tABS / tACOS) / tASIN) / tATAN) / tBLENGTH) / tCOS) / tEXISTS) / tEXP) / tFORMAT) / tHIBOUND) / tHIINDEX) / tLENGTH) / tLOBOUND) / tLOINDEX) / tLOG2) / tLOG10) / tLOG) / tNVL) / tODD) / tROLESOF) / tSIN) / tSIZEOF) / tSQRT) / tTAN) / tTYPEOF) / tUSEDIN) / tVALUE_IN) / tVALUE_UNIQUE) / tVALUE)) as builtInFunction
  builtInProcedure = ((tINSERT / tREMOVE)) as builtInProcedure
  caseAction = (((((caseLabel *(op_comma caseLabel))) as listOf_caseLabel op_colon) stmt)) as caseAction
  caseLabel = (expression) as caseLabel
  caseStmt = (((((((tCASE selector) tOF) (*(caseAction)) as caseAction) [ ((tOTHERWISE op_colon) stmt) ]) tEND_CASE) op_delim)) as caseStmt
  compoundStmt = ((((tBEGIN (1*(stmt)) as stmt) tEND) op_delim)) as compoundStmt
  concreteTypes = (((aggregationTypes / simpleTypes) / typeRef)) as concreteTypes
  constantBody = ((((((constantId op_colon) instantiableType) op_decl) expression) op_delim)) as constantBody
  constantDecl = ((((tCONSTANT (1*(constantBody)) as constantBody) tEND_CONSTANT) op_delim)) as constantDecl
  constantFactor = ((builtInConstant / constantRef)) as constantFactor
  constantId = (simpleId) as constantId
  constantRef = (constantId) as constantRef
  constructedTypes = ((enumerationType / selectType)) as constructedTypes
  declaration = (((((entityDecl / functionDecl) / procedureDecl) / subtypeConstraintDecl) / typeDecl)) as declaration
  delim = spaces ((";") as delim)
  deriveClause = ((tDERIVE (1*(derivedAttr)) as derivedAttr)) as deriveClause
  derivedAttr = ((((((attributeDecl op_colon) parameterType) op_decl) expression) op_delim)) as derivedAttr
  digit = (%x30-39)
  digits = (digit *(digit))
  domainRule = (([ (ruleLabelId op_colon) ] expression)) as domainRule
  element = ((expression [ (op_colon repetition) ])) as element
  embeddedRemark = (("(*)" / (("(*" *((!"*)" (embeddedRemark / any_char)))) "*)"))) as embeddedRemark
  encodedCharacter = (((octet octet) octet) octet)
  encodedStringLiteral = (spaces (((("\"" 1*(encodedCharacter)) "\"")) as str)) as encodedStringLiteral
  entityBody = ((((((*(explicitAttr)) as explicitAttr [deriveClause]) [inverseClause]) [uniqueClause]) [whereClause])) as entityBody
  entityConstructor = ((((entityRef op_leftparen) [((expression *(op_comma expression))) as listOf_expression]) op_rightparen)) as entityConstructor
  entityDecl = ((((entityHead entityBody) tEND_ENTITY) op_delim)) as entityDecl
  entityHead = ((((tENTITY entityId) subsuper) op_delim)) as entityHead
  entityId = (simpleId) as entityId
  entityRef = (entityId) as entityRef
  enumerationExtension = (((tBASED_ON typeRef) [ (tWITH enumerationItems) ])) as enumerationExtension
  enumerationId = (simpleId) as enumerationId
  enumerationItem = (enumerationId) as enumerationItem
  enumerationItems = (((op_leftparen ((enumerationItem *(op_comma enumerationItem))) as listOf_enumerationItem) op_rightparen)) as enumerationItems
  enumerationRef = (enumerationId) as enumerationRef
  enumerationReference = (([ (typeRef op_period) ] enumerationRef)) as enumerationReference
  enumerationType = ((([tEXTENSIBLE] tENUMERATION) [ ((tOF enumerationItems) / enumerationExtension) ])) as enumerationType
  escapeStmt = ((tESCAPE op_delim)) as escapeStmt
  explicitAttr = (((((((attributeDecl *(op_comma attributeDecl))) as listOf_attributeDecl op_colon) [tOPTIONAL]) parameterType) op_delim)) as explicitAttr
  expression = ((simpleExpression [ (relOpExtended (simpleExpression) as rhs) ])) as expression
  factor = ((simpleFactor [ (op_double_asterisk (simpleFactor) as rhs) ])) as factor
  formalParameter = (((((parameterId *(op_comma parameterId))) as listOf_parameterId op_colon) parameterType)) as formalParameter
  functionCall = (((builtInFunction / functionRef) [actualParameterList])) as functionCall
  functionDecl = (((((functionHead algorithmHead) (1*(stmt)) as stmt) tEND_FUNCTION) op_delim)) as functionDecl
  functionHead = ((((((tFUNCTION functionId) [ ((op_leftparen ((formalParameter *(op_delim formalParameter))) as listOf_formalParameter) op_rightparen) ]) op_colon) parameterType) (op_delim) as op_delim2)) as functionHead
  functionId = (simpleId) as functionId
  functionRef = (functionId) as functionRef
  generalAggregationTypes = ((((generalArrayType / generalBagType) / generalListType) / generalSetType)) as generalAggregationTypes
  generalArrayType = ((((((tARRAY [boundSpec]) tOF) [tOPTIONAL]) [tUNIQUE]) parameterType)) as generalArrayType
  generalBagType = ((((tBAG [boundSpec]) tOF) parameterType)) as generalBagType
  generalizedTypes = ((((aggregateType / generalAggregationTypes) / genericEntityType) / genericType)) as generalizedTypes
  generalListType = (((((tLIST [boundSpec]) tOF) [tUNIQUE]) parameterType)) as generalListType
  generalRef = ((parameterRef / variableId)) as generalRef
  generalSetType = ((((tSET [boundSpec]) tOF) parameterType)) as generalSetType
  genericEntityType = ((tGENERIC_ENTITY [ (op_colon typeLabel) ])) as genericEntityType
  genericType = ((tGENERIC [ (op_colon typeLabel) ])) as genericType
  groupQualifier = ((op_double_backslash entityRef)) as groupQualifier
  hexDigit = (%x30-39 / %x61-66 / %x41-46)
  ifStmtElseStatements = ((1*(stmt)) as stmt) as ifStmtElseStatements
  ifStmtStatements = ((1*(stmt)) as stmt) as ifStmtStatements
  ifStmt = (((((((tIF logicalExpression) tTHEN) ifStmtStatements) [ (tELSE ifStmtElseStatements) ]) tEND_IF) op_delim)) as ifStmt
  incrementControl = ((((((variableId op_decl) bound1) tTO) bound2) [ (tBY increment) ])) as incrementControl
  increment = (numericExpression) as increment
  index1 = (index) as index1
  index2 = (index) as index2
  index = (numericExpression) as index
  indexQualifier = ((((op_leftbracket index1) [ (op_colon index2) ]) op_rightbracket)) as indexQualifier
  instantiableType = ((concreteTypes / entityRef)) as instantiableType
  integerLiteral = (spaces ((digits) as str)) as integerLiteral
  integerType = (tINTEGER) as integerType
  interfaceSpecification = ((referenceClause / useClause)) as interfaceSpecification
  intervalHigh = (simpleExpression) as intervalHigh
  intervalItem = (simpleExpression) as intervalItem
  intervalLow = (simpleExpression) as intervalLow
  interval = (((((((op_left_curly_brace intervalLow) intervalOp) intervalItem) (intervalOp) as intervalOp2) intervalHigh) op_right_curly_brace)) as interval
  intervalOp = ((op_less_equal / op_less_than)) as intervalOp
  inverseAttr = (((((((attributeDecl op_colon) inverseAttrType) tFOR) [ (entityRef op_period) ]) attributeRef) op_delim)) as inverseAttr
  inverseAttrType = (([ (((tSET / tBAG) [boundSpec]) tOF) ] entityRef)) as inverseAttrType
  inverseClause = ((tINVERSE (1*(inverseAttr)) as inverseAttr)) as inverseClause
  letter = (%x61-7A / %x41-5A)
  listType = (((((tLIST [boundSpec]) tOF) [tUNIQUE]) instantiableType)) as listType
  literal = (((((binaryLiteral / logicalLiteral) / realLiteral) / integerLiteral) / stringLiteral)) as literal
  localDecl = ((((tLOCAL (1*(localVariable)) as localVariable) tEND_LOCAL) op_delim)) as localDecl
  localVariable = (((((((variableId *(op_comma variableId))) as listOf_variableId op_colon) parameterType) [ (op_decl expression) ]) op_delim)) as localVariable
  logicalExpression = (expression) as logicalExpression
  logicalLiteral = (((tFALSE / tTRUE) / tUNKNOWN)) as logicalLiteral
  logicalType = (tLOGICAL) as logicalType
  multiplicationLikeOp = ((((((op_asterisk / op_slash) / tDIV) / tMOD) / tAND) / op_double_pipe)) as multiplicationLikeOp
  namedTypeOrRename = ((namedTypes [ (tAS (entityId / typeId)) ])) as namedTypeOrRename
  namedTypes = ((entityRef / typeRef)) as namedTypes
  nullStmt = (op_delim) as nullStmt
  numberType = (tNUMBER) as numberType
  numericExpression = (simpleExpression) as numericExpression
  octet = (hexDigit hexDigit)
  oneOf = ((((tONEOF op_leftparen) ((supertypeExpression *(op_comma supertypeExpression))) as listOf_supertypeExpression) op_rightparen)) as oneOf
  op_asterisk = (spaces ("*" as str)) as op_asterisk
  op_colon = (spaces (":" as str)) as op_colon
  op_colon_equals_colon = (spaces (":=:" as str)) as op_colon_equals_colon
  op_colon_less_greater_colon = (spaces (":<>:" as str)) as op_colon_less_greater_colon
  op_comma = (spaces ("," as str)) as op_comma
  op_decl = (spaces (":=" as str)) as op_decl
  op_delim = (spaces (";" as str)) as op_delim
  op_double_asterisk = (spaces ("**" as str)) as op_double_asterisk
  op_double_backslash = (spaces ("\\" as str)) as op_double_backslash
  op_double_pipe = (spaces ("||" as str)) as op_double_pipe
  op_equals = (spaces ("=" as str)) as op_equals
  op_greater_equal = (spaces (">=" as str)) as op_greater_equal
  op_greater_than = (spaces (">" as str)) as op_greater_than
  op_leftbracket = (spaces ("[" as str)) as op_leftbracket
  op_left_curly_brace = (spaces ("{" as str)) as op_left_curly_brace
  op_leftparen = (spaces ("(" as str)) as op_leftparen
  op_less_equal = (spaces ("<=" as str)) as op_less_equal
  op_less_greater = (spaces ("<>" as str)) as op_less_greater
  op_less_than = (spaces ("<" as str)) as op_less_than
  op_minus = (spaces ("-" as str)) as op_minus
  op_period = (spaces ("." as str)) as op_period
  op_pipe = (spaces ("|" as str)) as op_pipe
  op_plus = (spaces ("+" as str)) as op_plus
  op_query_begin = (spaces ("<*" as str)) as op_query_begin
  op_query_end = (spaces ("*>" as str)) as op_query_end
  op_question_mark = (spaces ("?" as str)) as op_question_mark
  op_rightbracket = (spaces ("]" as str)) as op_rightbracket
  op_right_curly_brace = (spaces ("}" as str)) as op_right_curly_brace
  op_rightparen = (spaces (")" as str)) as op_rightparen
  op_slash = (spaces ("/" as str)) as op_slash
  parameter = (expression) as parameter
  parameterId = (simpleId) as parameterId
  parameterRef = (parameterId) as parameterRef
  parameterType = (((generalizedTypes / namedTypes) / simpleTypes)) as parameterType
  population = (entityRef) as population
  precisionSpec = (numericExpression) as precisionSpec
  primary = ((literal / (qualifiableFactor (*(qualifier)) as qualifier))) as primary
  procedureCallStmt = ((((builtInProcedure / procedureRef) [actualParameterList]) op_delim)) as procedureCallStmt
  procedureDecl = (((((procedureHead algorithmHead) (*(stmt)) as stmt) tEND_PROCEDURE) op_delim)) as procedureDecl
  procedureHeadParameter = (([tVAR] formalParameter)) as procedureHeadParameter
  procedureHead = ((((tPROCEDURE procedureId) [ ((op_leftparen ((procedureHeadParameter *(op_delim procedureHeadParameter))) as listOf_procedureHeadParameter) op_rightparen) ]) (op_delim) as op_delim2)) as procedureHead
  procedureId = (simpleId) as procedureId
  procedureRef = (procedureId) as procedureRef
  qualifiableFactor = (((((functionCall / attributeRef) / constantFactor) / generalRef) / population)) as qualifiableFactor
  qualifiedAttribute = (((tSELF groupQualifier) attributeQualifier)) as qualifiedAttribute
  qualifier = (((attributeQualifier / groupQualifier) / indexQualifier)) as qualifier
  queryExpression = ((((((((tQUERY op_leftparen) variableId) op_query_begin) aggregateSource) op_pipe) logicalExpression) op_rightparen)) as queryExpression
  realLiteral = (spaces (((((digits ".") [digits]) [ ((("e" / "E") [sign]) digits) ])) as str)) as realLiteral
  realType = ((tREAL [ ((op_leftparen precisionSpec) op_rightparen) ])) as realType
  redeclaredAttribute = ((qualifiedAttribute [ (tRENAMED attributeId) ])) as redeclaredAttribute
  referenceClause = (((((tREFERENCE tFROM) schemaRef) [ ((op_leftparen ((resourceOrRename *(op_comma resourceOrRename))) as listOf_resourceOrRename) op_rightparen) ]) op_delim)) as referenceClause
  referencedAttribute = ((attributeRef / qualifiedAttribute)) as referencedAttribute
  relOpExtended = (((relOp / tIN) / tLIKE)) as relOpExtended
  relOp = ((((((((op_less_equal / op_greater_equal) / op_less_greater) / op_less_than) / op_greater_than) / op_equals) / op_colon_less_greater_colon) / op_colon_equals_colon)) as relOp
  renameId = (((((constantId / entityId) / functionId) / procedureId) / typeId)) as renameId
  repeatControl = ((([incrementControl] [whileControl]) [untilControl])) as repeatControl
  repeatStmt = ((((((tREPEAT repeatControl) op_delim) (1*(stmt)) as stmt) tEND_REPEAT) (op_delim) as op_delim2)) as repeatStmt
  repetition = (numericExpression) as repetition
  resourceOrRename = ((resourceRef [ (tAS renameId) ])) as resourceOrRename
  resourceRef = (((((constantRef / entityRef) / functionRef) / procedureRef) / typeRef)) as resourceRef
  returnStmt = (((tRETURN [ ((op_leftparen expression) op_rightparen) ]) op_delim)) as returnStmt
  ruleDecl = ((((((ruleHead algorithmHead) (*(stmt)) as stmt) whereClause) tEND_RULE) op_delim)) as ruleDecl
  ruleHead = (((((((tRULE ruleId) tFOR) op_leftparen) ((entityRef *(op_comma entityRef))) as listOf_entityRef) op_rightparen) op_delim)) as ruleHead
  ruleId = (simpleId) as ruleId
  ruleLabelId = (simpleId) as ruleLabelId
  ruleLabelRef = (ruleLabelId) as ruleLabelRef
  ruleRef = (ruleId) as ruleRef
  schemaBodyDeclaration = ((declaration / ruleDecl)) as schemaBodyDeclaration
  schemaBody = ((((*(interfaceSpecification)) as interfaceSpecification [constantDecl]) (*(schemaBodyDeclaration)) as schemaBodyDeclaration)) as schemaBody
  schemaDecl = (((((((tSCHEMA schemaId) [schemaVersionId]) op_delim) schemaBody) tEND_SCHEMA) (op_delim) as op_delim2)) as schemaDecl
  schemaId = (simpleId) as schemaId
  schemaRef = (schemaId) as schemaRef
  schemaVersionId = (stringLiteral) as schemaVersionId
  selectExtension = (((tBASED_ON typeRef) [ (tWITH selectList) ])) as selectExtension
  selectList = (((op_leftparen ((namedTypes *(op_comma namedTypes))) as listOf_namedTypes) op_rightparen)) as selectList
  selector = (expression) as selector
  selectType = ((([ (tEXTENSIBLE [tGENERIC_ENTITY]) ] tSELECT) [ (selectList / selectExtension) ])) as selectType
  setType = ((((tSET [boundSpec]) tOF) instantiableType)) as setType
  sign = ("+" / "-")
  simpleExpression = ((term (*((((addLikeOp) as operator term)) as item)) as rhs)) as simpleExpression
  simpleFactor = ((((((((simpleFactorExpression / aggregateInitializer) / entityConstructor) / interval) / queryExpression) / stringLiteral) / simpleFactorUnaryExpression) / enumerationReference)) as simpleFactor
  simpleFactorExpression = ((((op_leftparen expression) op_rightparen) / primary)) as simpleFactorExpression
  simpleFactorUnaryExpression = ((unaryOp simpleFactorExpression)) as simpleFactorUnaryExpression
  simpleId = (!(anyKeyword) (spaces ((((%x61-7A / %x41-5A / "_") *(%x61-7A / %x41-5A / %x30-39 / "_"))) as str)) as simpleId)
  simpleStringLiteral = (spaces (((("'" *(!"'" any_char)) "'")) as str)) as simpleStringLiteral
  simpleTypes = (((((((binaryType / booleanType) / integerType) / logicalType) / numberType) / realType) / stringType)) as simpleTypes
  skipStmt = ((tSKIP op_delim)) as skipStmt
  space = (((" " / "\r" / "\n" / "\t" / " ") / embeddedRemark) / tailRemark)
  spaces = (*(space)) as spaces
  stmt = (((((((((((aliasStmt / assignmentStmt) / caseStmt) / compoundStmt) / escapeStmt) / ifStmt) / nullStmt) / procedureCallStmt) / repeatStmt) / returnStmt) / skipStmt)) as stmt
  stringLiteral = ((simpleStringLiteral / encodedStringLiteral)) as stringLiteral
  stringType = ((tSTRING [widthSpec])) as stringType
  subsuper = (([supertypeConstraint] [subtypeDeclaration])) as subsuper
  subtypeConstraintBody = ((([abstractSupertype] [totalOver]) [ (supertypeExpression op_delim) ])) as subtypeConstraintBody
  subtypeConstraintDecl = ((((subtypeConstraintHead subtypeConstraintBody) tEND_SUBTYPE_CONSTRAINT) op_delim)) as subtypeConstraintDecl
  subtypeConstraintHead = (((((tSUBTYPE_CONSTRAINT subtypeConstraintId) tFOR) entityRef) op_delim)) as subtypeConstraintHead
  subtypeConstraintId = (simpleId) as subtypeConstraintId
  subtypeConstraintRef = (subtypeConstraintId) as subtypeConstraintRef
  subtypeConstraint = ((((tOF op_leftparen) supertypeExpression) op_rightparen)) as subtypeConstraint
  subtypeDeclaration = (((((((tSUBTYPE tOF) op_leftparen) entityRef) *(op_comma entityRef)) op_rightparen)) as listOf_entityRef) as subtypeDeclaration
  supertypeConstraint = (((abstractSupertypeDeclaration / abstractEntityDeclaration) / supertypeRule)) as supertypeConstraint
  supertypeExpression = ((supertypeFactor (*((((tANDOR) as operator supertypeFactor)) as item)) as rhs)) as supertypeExpression
  supertypeFactor = ((supertypeTerm (*((((tAND) as operator supertypeTerm)) as item)) as rhs)) as supertypeFactor
  supertypeRule = ((tSUPERTYPE subtypeConstraint)) as supertypeRule
  supertypeTerm = (((entityRef / oneOf) / ((op_leftparen supertypeExpression) op_rightparen))) as supertypeTerm
  syntax = ((((spaces) as spaces (1*(schemaDecl)) as schemaDecl) (spaces) as trailer)) as syntax
  tailRemark = ((("--" *(!"\n" any_char)) [ "\n" ])) as tailRemark
  term = ((factor (*(((multiplicationLikeOp factor)) as item)) as rhs)) as term
  totalOver = (((((tTOTAL_OVER op_leftparen) ((entityRef *(op_comma entityRef))) as listOf_entityRef) op_rightparen) op_delim)) as totalOver
  typeDecl = ((((((((tTYPE typeId) op_equals) underlyingType) op_delim) [whereClause]) tEND_TYPE) (op_delim) as op_delim2)) as typeDecl
  typeId = (simpleId) as typeId
  typeLabelId = (simpleId) as typeLabelId
  typeLabelRef = (typeLabelId) as typeLabelRef
  typeLabel = ((typeLabelId / typeLabelRef)) as typeLabel
  typeRef = (typeId) as typeRef
  unaryOp = (((op_plus / op_minus) / tNOT)) as unaryOp
  underlyingType = ((concreteTypes / constructedTypes)) as underlyingType
  uniqueClause = ((tUNIQUE (((uniqueRule op_delim) *(uniqueRule (op_delim) as op_delim2))) as listOf_uniqueRule)) as uniqueClause
  uniqueRule = (([ (ruleLabelId op_colon) ] ((referencedAttribute *(op_comma referencedAttribute))) as listOf_referencedAttribute)) as uniqueRule
  untilControl = ((tUNTIL logicalExpression)) as untilControl
  useClause = (((((tUSE tFROM) schemaRef) [ ((op_leftparen ((namedTypeOrRename *(op_comma namedTypeOrRename))) as listOf_namedTypeOrRename) op_rightparen) ]) op_delim)) as useClause
  variableId = (simpleId) as variableId
  variableRef = (variableId) as variableRef
  whereClause = ((tWHERE (*(domainRule op_delim)) as listOf_domainRule)) as whereClause
  whileControl = ((tWHILE logicalExpression)) as whileControl
  width = (numericExpression) as width
  widthSpec = ((((op_leftparen width) op_rightparen) [tFIXED])) as widthSpec
  tABS = ((spaces ((%i"abs" !((%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / %x5F))) as str)) as tABS)
  tABSTRACT = ((spaces ((%i"abstract" !((%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / %x5F))) as str)) as tABSTRACT)
